summary.title: Summary

notRestored.one: {count} file this job replaced couldn't be brought back: their new versions stay.
notRestored.other: {count} files this job replaced couldn't be brought back: their new versions stay.

notRemovedUndo.one: {count} file couldn't be removed (see the report).
notRemovedUndo.other: {count} files couldn't be removed (see the report).

summary.checksumError: The checksum file could not be written: {why}
summary.durabilityError: The destination reported an error while the files were saved to disk: {why}. Check the drive and run the copy again.
summary.reportError: The report could not be saved: {why}

retryHelp.one: Sets up a new copy of just the {count} failed file; press Start to run it.
retryHelp.other: Sets up a new copy of just the {count} failed files; press Start to run it.

questionQueue.copy: Stop copying and stop the queue?
questionQueue.mirror: Stop mirroring and stop the queue?
questionQueue.check: Stop verifying and stop the queue?

stop.notStarted: This job hasn't started yet: nothing was written for it.

left.check: Nothing was changed: a check only reads files.
left.mirror: Files already copied stay; the file in progress is removed. Files deleted in the origin are left in the destination.
left.copyListed: Files already copied stay and are listed in the checksum file; the file in progress is removed.
left.copy: Files already copied stay; the file in progress is removed.

stop.checkedSoFar: Nothing was changed: the files checked so far are in the summary.
stop.removeCopied: The file in progress and the files already copied are removed.
stop.alsoRemove: Also remove the files already copied
stop.alsoRemoveHelp: The destination goes back to how it was. Files this job replaced come back only from a mirror's archive.

finishing.undo: Secopy finishes putting the destination back as it was first, then quits.
finishing.archive: Secopy finishes archiving the files gone from the origin first, then quits.
finishing.delete: Secopy finishes deleting the files gone from the origin first, then quits.

progress.title: Progress
progress.lookingAtSource: Looking at the source and the destination before this job starts…
progress.undoing: Putting the destination back as it was…

smallFiles.name: Small files
smallFiles.help: Files under 8 MB. Many are copied at once, so they're counted together instead of getting a bar each.

progress.resumeHelp: Carries on from where it paused (Space).

pauseHelp.copy: Stops reading and writing until you resume (Space).

cancelHelp.queue: Asks first, then stops this job and the queue (⌘.).
cancelHelp.job: Asks first, then stops the job (⌘.).

copy.systemHint: Files computers leave behind, like .DS_Store, ._ files and Thumbs.db. They're never copied.
copy.title: New copy
copy.dropSource: Drop a directory or files here, or choose them.
copy.dropDestination: Drop the destination directory here, or choose it.
copy.aboutVerifyingText: Copy & Verify reads every copy back from the destination and checks it against the source's checksum; a copy that doesn't match is copied again. Copy only copies: faster, but nothing is checked.
copy.addToQueueHelp: Adds this copy, as set up now, to the Queue; it runs when you start the queue.

notEmpty.one: Already contains {count} item. Identical files will be skipped.
notEmpty.other: Already contains {count} items. Identical files will be skipped.

preflight.identicalHint: Files with the same name, size and date (within 2 seconds) as one already in the destination. They aren't copied or read.

identicalSkipped.one: {count} identical file will be skipped (not checked).
identicalSkipped.other: {count} identical files will be skipped (not checked).

preflight.existingHint: Files with the same name as one already in the destination, but a different size or date. Keep both: the new one is copied with a number added to its name. Overwrite: the one there is replaced. Skip: the one there is left as it is.

stale.one: {count} unfinished file from an interrupted copy will be replaced.
stale.other: {count} unfinished files from an interrupted copy will be replaced.

delete.title: Delete preset?

presets.title: Copy presets

empty.what: A copy preset saves a source and its settings (whether that directory itself is copied, and which file types), so a copy you do often is set up in one step: choose the preset in the main window.
empty.how: Create one with “+ New preset”, or with “Save as…” in the main window.
